comment: Exact, finite lists driving the 'the application still serves' check (planning-skill report 17 §1, P0). Detection is LITERAL, case-insensitive substring membership. indicators: phrases that signal a goal changes module state, schema, or configuration — a hit in any of a goal's step files or testing companions marks the goal state-changing. serve_phrases: phrases that prove a verification acceptance condition or testing companion actually exercises the running application. A state-changing goal whose verification units contain none of them gets a WARN. Both lists must stay conservative: an indicator must always imply state change, and a serve phrase must only appear when the app is exercised.
